issue.title: Retain Windows installer reinstall and stage-cleanup regressions in CI
issue.body:
Priority: P3. Follow-up from actual Claude Code Opus 5.5 xhigh formal scan 1 of PR #497 at head `2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c`, root cause R1.

The permanent Windows PowerShell 5.1 installer acceptance test installs into absent destinations. It does not retain a same-path reinstall regression for the File.Replace branch, pinned-shortcut publication or successful stage-directory cleanup. The exact current candidate has separate hosted reinstall/pinned coverage and a composed rollback witness; this is a future regression-coverage gap, not an observed current failure.

Acceptance:
- Add a second public PS5.1 installation over the same disposable outputs with an actually changed environment setting. Verify updated configuration, final shortcut metadata/AppUserModelID, unchanged source and aliases, and an empty store.
- Cover an explicitly supplied disposable pinned-shortcut destination.
- Assert no owned gg-launcher-stage-* directory remains at the installation and shortcut anchors after success.
- Evaluate a bounded production rollback regression using a genuine Windows sharing handle; preserve native process/cleanup receipts and do not weaken the safe refusal or identity checks.
- Preserve coverage and ordinary CI budgets and use no owner installation, Desktop, shortcuts or store.

Dedup: all-state issue searches for installer/reinstall, gg-launcher-stage and related terms found no matching issue. #496 is artifact retention, #436 delivers current validation/publication correctness, and neither owns this ongoing test-strength gap.

Disposition: DEFER-ISSUE, parked under backlog without a pickup gate. This does not expand the dispatched four-intent batch. Follow docs/15 and opposite-family review when separately dispatched.

labels.name: backlog
labels.description: Parked until further notice: agents do not pick it up; it carries no gate label
